description: This file defines a UI widget class 'LogModeWidget' that creates a panel containing a checkbox for toggling full logging. It sets an action listener on the checkbox to send a command via 'CommandQueue' when toggled.

classes.name: LogModeWidget
classes.description: A UI component that provides a checkbox to enable or disable full logging, and sends a command when toggled.

methods.name: LogModeWidget
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UI panel and checkbox, and attaches the action listener.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the JPanel containing the logging mode checkbox.
